newsitem.title: INDIA: Lower fresh export demand hurts India castor rates.
newsitem.headline: Lower fresh export demand hurts India castor rates.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices on Wednesday fell to 1,167/1,168 rupees per quintal from 1,174/1,175 rupees in the absence of fresh export demand, dealers said.
"Foreign buyers are offering Indian castoroil at $690 per tonne while sellers are at $715/720," one dealer said.

Groundnut oil rose to 349/350 rupees per 10 kg from 346/347 rupees on fresh seasonal buying while arrivals remained low at 60/70 tonnes. "Unseasonal rain in producing centres has cut arrivals from these centres," he said.
In Rajkot spot oil rose by five rupees to 525 rupees per 15 kg partly due to rising world prices, the dealer said.
The Bombay markets will be shut on Thursday as traders protest a tax hike. It will reopen on Friday.
